7. Preservation of the fixed guarantee and review disposition

I found no selected proposal that adds a public Pre/domain cap, weakens an original reference/Post/variant, introduces an assumed lemma, lowers the proof/control floor, accepts a native resource failure as a refusal, or suppresses original checked Ghost code. The fixed requirements and byte-preservation list are explicit (D3:137-165). Conserved retains Shape and both kind totals; Contained retains the first loop and the original every-target combined-sum invariant; Check changes only its capacity comparison, preserving status order (D3:360-378,911-940; C5/core/resource_run_ledger.ads:236-265,377-443). Algorithm A's normalization, signed side split, Both_Kinds aggregate and residual carry design remain eligible on the original domain, subject to their full body/equivalence/bounds proofs.

The following are conditions on eligibility, not permitted reductions:

- PFX-3 cannot remove or weaken the original termination/variant guarantee merely to silence a new wrapper warning (D3:1310).
- A handler/finally pattern that requires new Off, assumed reachability, suppressed checks or a waived strict warning fails its gate; use only a preserving, proved alternative (D3:1374-1392,1445-1454).
- Ghost-only retirement/removal of Exact_Value/Amount/Sum is explicitly incompatible, even if separately approved as a changed requirement; it cannot close the fixed target (D3:1666).
- Selecting release to hide checked Ghost is explicitly rejected (D3:410); the project currently defaults to checks/-gnata (C5/core/worldline_core_sources.gpr:8-19). A default setting is not a loaded-build observation.
- Finite higher Python limits, resource/size admission presented as a cost repair, and caught failures converted to accepted refusals remain ineligible (D3:1802-1809).
- OD-1 library/model/runtime and F-B2/F-B3 API changes require concrete operator choices and equivalent executable capabilities for every original caller, while proof/native acceptance remains separate (D3:1456-1461,1659-1667).

The full matching-source proof remains required under the frozen strict command, protected floor 251, ordered required-name roster, sole original Off boundary, zero unproved/justified/Assume, and all strict warning obligations resolved (H/HANDOFF.md:155-162; D3:2020-2028,2049). The complete original ordinary and lifetime controls are retained; finite passing controls could not replace required full-domain proof or native correspondence. Every OPEN obligation in D3:2034-2054 remains OPEN after this design review.

The remaining required changes repair source-supported codec/inventory, coverage and cost-map errors. They do not require a public-domain change or abandonment of the primary comparison/cleanup architecture. The design verdict is ENDORSED_WITH_REQUIRED_CHANGES. This is a conditional design endorsement only; V3-RC1..V3-RC3 are mandatory before treating the affected packages as repaired. No implementation, proof, native, source or Phase One acceptance is granted, and no operator option is selected. The related D2 and R-1 reviews/decisions remain independent obligations.
